faq.description: Answers to common questions about the supercharged 3.0 V6 petrol engine in the Land Rover Discovery 4. If yours is not covered, our team can help.

faqs.q: Can a Range Rover V6 engine fit my Discovery 4?
faqs.a: Not without careful checks. Range Rover, Velar and Jaguar versions differ in output, ancillaries and wiring, so we compare your VIN and engine code with any replacement and confirm your market specification before supply.

faqs.q: How do used, reconditioned and rebuilt 306PS engines compare?
faqs.a: A used engine comes from a donor vehicle, a reconditioned engine is stripped and given new wear parts, and a rebuild restores your existing engine. We recommend an option after assessing the fault and vehicle.

faqs.q: Can I buy a Discovery 4 V6 petrol engine supply only?
faqs.a: Yes. Trade buyers, independent garages and private customers with their own mechanic can buy supply only. Alternatively, choose supply and fit and our technicians will install the engine at our Grays, Essex workshop.

faqs.q: What affects the Discovery 4 engine replacement cost for a 306PS?
faqs.a: The cost depends on the engine option, the condition of your current engine, any supercharger or cooling parts needed and the labour involved, including body lifting. Send your registration or VIN for a written quote.

faqs.q: Is there a warranty on a replacement 306PS engine?
faqs.a: Warranty cover depends on the engine option and whether we carry out the installation. We confirm the exact terms in writing with your quote, so you know what is covered before work begins.

faqs.q: Do you deliver Land Rover V6 engines across the UK?
faqs.a: Yes. We deliver engines throughout the United Kingdom from our Grays workshop. Delivery arrangements and costs are confirmed in your quote, and supply and fit customers can bring their Discovery to us.

faqs.q: How long does a 306PS engine replacement usually take?
faqs.a: The timescale depends on engine availability, whether a rebuild is needed, any body-lift work and additional repairs found during inspection. We give you an estimated timeframe with your quote and keep you informed.

workshopIntro.title: Repair, Rebuild or Replace Your 306PS?
workshopIntro.description: The fault, mileage and value of your Discovery 4 decide the right route. Coil, isolator, water pump and oil leak faults can usually be repaired individually. If timing chain failure or overheating has caused internal damage, a rebuild or Land Rover Discovery 4 306PS engine replacement is usually more practical.
paragraphs: A supercharged V6 relies on an efficient cooling system and clean oil. Where relevant, we inspect the water pump, radiator, thermostat, coolant pipes and supercharger drive, check the ignition system and gearbox, and renew the oil, filters and coolant before the engine runs.

Send your registration or VIN with a short description of the symptoms. We will confirm compatibility, explain the options and quote for supply only, supply and fit at our Grays workshop, or delivery across the UK.

engineProblems.title: Common Discovery 4 V6 Petrol Problems
engineProblems.description: The supercharged V6 usually gives early warnings, and prompt checks help prevent more serious engine damage.

cards.title: Timing Drive Rattle on Start-Up
cards.description: A brief rattle after a cold start, uneven idle or camshaft correlation codes may indicate worn timing chain tensioners, guides or chains. We inspect the timing drive and camshaft timing.

cards.title: Supercharger Isolator Knock
cards.description: A knocking or rattling sound at idle that fades with engine speed can point to a worn supercharger isolator or drive coupling. We assess the supercharger drive components.

cards.title: Water Pump and Coolant Leaks
cards.description: Coolant loss, a sweet smell or rising temperature may come from a failing water pump, the thermostat housing or ageing coolant pipes. We pressure-test the cooling system for leaks.
cards.action: Fuel rail and injector leak-off test

cards.title: Intake Valve Carbon Build-Up
cards.description: Rough idle, hesitation or misfire codes on higher-mileage engines may be linked to carbon deposits forming on the intake valves. We assess running quality and inspect intake condition.

cards.title: Ignition Coil and Plug Misfires
cards.description: Juddering, a flashing engine light or poor acceleration are often caused by worn spark plugs or failing ignition coils. We test the ignition system cylinder by cylinder.

cards.title: Cam Cover and Front Seal Leaks
cards.description: Oil seeping onto hot components, burning smells or smoke may come from hardened cam cover gaskets or the front crankshaft seal. We locate the leak and inspect the seals.

engineOverview.title: Land Rover Discovery 4 306PS Engine: The Complete Supercharged V6 Guide
paragraphs: The Land Rover Discovery 4 306PS engine is the 3.0-litre supercharged V6 petrol fitted to later Discovery 4 models in certain markets. Refined and powerful, it can develop timing chain wear, supercharger isolator noise, water pump leaks and carbon build-up, leading owners to seek repair or replacement.

This 3.0 V6 Range Rover engine also appears in Range Rover, Range Rover Sport, Velar and Jaguar models, with different outputs, ancillaries and wiring. We identify the correct Discovery 4 engine by checking your VIN, engine code and registration before supply.

Whether you need a targeted repair, an engine rebuild or a complete Land Rover Discovery 4 306PS engine replacement, our team inspects the vehicle and explains each option. Call us or send your registration for a written quote.
